# oriz Chat

> Free, streaming AI chat that runs entirely in your browser. Multi-turn conversations, full model picker with automatic multi-provider failover, markdown rendering, on-device history, prompt presets, and export. 100% client-side — no upload, no signup, no API key.

## App

- [Live app](https://chat.oriz.in): the chat tool — pick a model, choose a preset, talk to the AI, all in-browser.
- [llms-full.txt](https://chat.oriz.in/llms-full.txt): full plain-text content of the site for LLM ingestion.

## Features

- [Streaming chat](https://chat.oriz.in): token-by-token AI responses via g4f multi-provider, no API key.
- [Model picker](https://chat.oriz.in): every g4f model with automatic failover when a provider is down.
- [Prompt presets](https://chat.oriz.in): general, code, brainstorm, explain, rewrite, translate system prompts.
- [Markdown render](https://chat.oriz.in): sanitized markdown, fenced code, tables and lists.
- [Private history](https://chat.oriz.in): conversations persist in IndexedDB on your device; browse, reopen, delete.
- [Export](https://chat.oriz.in): download any conversation as Markdown or JSON.
